entities.name: Old P-TMSI signature
entities.description: Information element included by UE when certain conditions are met regarding P-TMSI signature, P-TMSI, RAI, and TIN status.

entities.name: UE holds valid P-TMSI signature, P-TMSI and RAI
entities.description: Condition where UE possesses valid P-TMSI signature, P-TMSI and RAI.

entities.name: TIN indicates P-TMSI or is deleted
entities.description: Condition where TIN either indicates P-TMSI or has been deleted.

entities.name: UE configured for AttachWithIMSI in new PLMN
entities.description: Condition where UE is configured for AttachWithIMSI and attaching in new PLMN that is neither registered PLMN nor in equivalent PLMNs list.

entities.name: UE shall not include Old P-TMSI signature IE
entities.description: Behavior where UE excludes Old P-TMSI signature IE under specific AttachWithIMSI configuration and PLMN conditions.

relations.description: Inclusion of Old P-TMSI signature IE is guarded by condition that UE holds valid P-TMSI signature, P-TMSI and RAI.
Inclusion of Old P-TMSI signature IE is guarded by condition that TIN indicates P-TMSI or is deleted.
Condition where UE is configured for AttachWithIMSI and attaching in new PLMN establishes the property that UE shall not include Old P-TMSI signature IE.
